Method of Attack: File-encrypting ransomware malware targeting organizations in public and private sectors
Discoverer: WMNF radio station and Florida Department of Law Enforcement
Impacted Systems: Town of Collierville, Tennessee computer systems
WMNF 88.5-FM radio station systems in Tampa, Florida
City of Lake City, Florida computers
City of Riviera Beach, Florida computers
Onondaga County Public Libraries (OCPL), New York systems
Syracuse City School District systems, New York
Henry County, Georgia budgeting and procurement systems, Planning and Zoning Department
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection of computer systems and servers
Indicators of Compromise: Systems infected with Ryuk ransomware strain
Radio digital displays showing 'Derek and the Dominos' band name
Payments of ransom in bitcoins (42 bitcoins in Lake City, 65 bitcoins in Riviera Beach)
Systems unavailable or disrupted (permits, public records, business services, budgeting, procurement)
Ransom notes and encrypted files identifiable by ID Ransomware service
